newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani interbank call rates remain high.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani interbank call rates remain high.

text.p: Pakistan's interbank money rates remained high on Thursday and dealers said they were likely to open higher after the Friday weekend.
Some borrowers crossed the 20 percent mark and started bidding at 21 and 22 percent, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said. However, most funds were traded at 20 percent.
Banks had to resort to the central bank's discount window for substantial amounts, he said. Borrowers who could not do so had to borrow at 21 to 23 percent.
